text: maria: FYI — Sara (from Acme) just escalated that rendered markdown in responses started breaking after this morning's rollout. They see extra closing code fences and stray HTML-escaped tags in places where previous model never did. Sara_cust: past 2 hours, every time we ask for a snippet the output now has trailing ````` or additional "" strings. Example from their response: ``` Here is the SQL you can run: ```sql SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = 1; ``` ``` They say the closing fence appears twice and an extra "" fragment is appended. Also sometimes stop sequences are ignored (we asked to stop at "--END--" and the model kept going). This started right after the model flavor rollout (rolling to v1.13-b). oliver: thanks — Maria, can you grab the request/responses and the model + rollout id? Also any customer prompt that reproduces reliably. maria: pasted the minimal repro from the customer below. Request metadata: model: openredwood-v1.13-b, rollout_id: r-2026-03-15-03, tokenization: default. curl they used: ``` curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ -d '{"model":"openredwood-v1.13-b","input":"Give me a markdown fenced code block with a SQL query and then STOP at --END--","stop":["--END--"]}' ``` response body: ``` {"id":"resp_123","output":"```sql\nSELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active=1;\n```\n--END--\n"} ``` raj: odd. deploy-bot shows the rollout completed at 1800123000, but canary was supposed to hold for 30m. deploy-bot: @channel rollout r-2026-03-15-03 to openredwood-v1.13-b: completed canary -> global at 1800123000 :rocket: deploy-bot: Deployment note: tokenizer mapping tweak applied for pretokenization edge-cases. laura: that 'tokenizer mapping tweak' is the change that touched how backticks and HTML-like sequences are handled. It's likely a tokenization merge that collapsed some token boundaries, which can change generated spacing/escape behavior and stop-seq alignment. This would explain trailing "" (an artifact when the generator emits a token that semantically closes an inline HTML escape). oliver: customer is in production, seeing volume. Priority: P2 for now but could be P1 if more customers. Do we have a quick mitigation (rollback or config)? raj: we can rollback the model variant to v1.13-a which previous canary used. I'll need approval to trigger. Also we should add a short-term server-side post-processing filter that strips stray terminal HTML tags and extra closing fences when the response format is markdown and stop sequences are present. That buys time. maria: Sara — would a rollback help? They replied: "Rollback is fine; we need stability. The content is getting ingested into our docs pipeline and breaks parsers." laura: repro notes for eng-ml/qa: sample prompt above reproduces ~90% on our internal reproducer when using v1.13-b. Key indicators: repeated closing fence or stray HTML fragments right after expected stop token. Hypothesis: tokenizer change shifted stop token alignment by one token; generator then emits an escape sequence token in place of stop. qa_bot: added test case to regression suite: markdown-fence-stopseq-leak. Running on both v1.13-a and v1.13-b in CI. raj: I'm going to open up a rollback pr for the rollout and trigger it if no objections in 10m. We should also capture request traces and full raw token stream from the customer (need their consent) to validate tokenization mapping. Maria, can you request raw log dump? maria: on it. Sara — can you share the raw response from the API (not just the rendered string) and confirm whether you're using any client-side postprocessing? Sara_cust: sending via secure upload link now. no client-side postprocessing, we just forward text to our markdown renderer. raj: rollback initiated to v1.13-a at 1800124800. I'll monitor metrics. deploy-bot: Rollback action: r-2026-03-15-03 -> revert to openredwood-v1.13-a at 1800124800 (initiated by raj) :wrench: oliver: thanks. Maria — please coordinate an incident report and include customer impact, repro, and root cause hypothesis. Also create a follow-up ticket for eng-ml to add a tokenization-aware stopseq check into our unit tests (and a dedicated prompt audit for markdown outputs). laura: follow-up: if tokenization mapping is the root cause we'll patch the mapping to preserve fence/backtick tokens as atomic where possible, and run full evals on markdown prompt suites before next canary. I will pair with QA on the test design. maria: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-02. Assigned to raj, laura, oliver. Will keep thread updated. Sara_cust: rollback fixed our flows — thanks for the quick response. We'll keep an eye and report if anything else crops up. oliver: great. Next steps: 1) eng-ml root cause + patch 2) eng-runtime integration test for stopseq + markdown 3) product communication for customers on the rollout window and rollback 4) add automated alert for spike in formats failing parser checks. maria: closing loop — will reopen if regression reappears. Thanks all :pray:
